name: Marian University Ancilla
tuition_note: Private single rate. 2026-27 traditional program tuition of $10,500/semester = $21,000/year from marian.edu/plymouth/about/tuition-and-fees.php (Ancilla/Plymouth campus schedule; nursing program is billed separately at $21,700/semester). On-campus housing exists at the campus (per marian.edu/plymouth/campus-life) but no room-only or room-and-board dollar amount is published on the official Plymouth/Ancilla tuition, campus-life, or housing pages; contact MUACHousing@marian.edu for rates. The $15,040 room+board figure on the main Indianapolis admissions page applies to the Indy campus, not Ancilla, so it was not used.
